heroSub: 10 hotels in central Rayong we've reviewed in depth — an international-brand hotel attached to a mall with a 29th-floor infinity pool, a design hotel with a bathtub, serviced apartments with kitchens for long stays, a quiet garden hotel, down to clean budget rooms under a thousand baht. heroStats: ✅ Honest takes from real reviews for every stay
introH2: 🏙️ How many kinds of hotels are there in Rayong city, and how do you pick the right one for your trip?
introHtml: When people think of Rayong, most picture Koh Samet, Mae Ramphueng Beach, and the sound of the waves. But Rayong city itself is the economic hub of the Eastern region, with people coming and going year-round to work in the industrial estates, attend conferences, and pass through — and that's why the city has a wider range of hotels than you'd expect · Some are tall international-brand hotels connected straight into a mall with a rooftop infinity pool, some are serviced apartments with in-room kitchens that suit a month-long stay, some are garden hotels set back for quiet right in the city, and some are clean budget rooms you can sleep in for a few hundred baht · A lot of people accidentally book a beachfront hotel when the trip is really about working in the city, and end up wasting time driving in and out every day · This article rounds up 10 downtown Rayong hotels we've reviewed in depth, all based on reading real guest reviews, with the upsides and the honest caveats, prices compared across 3 sites, and direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: Rayong has no rail transit; getting around the city is mainly by private car, Grab, or songthaew (shared pickup truck) · From Bangkok it's about a 2.5–3 hour drive via the motorway, and from U-Tapao Airport (UTP) it's roughly 30–50 min by car into the city, depending on the area · The stay areas in this article: Sukhumvit Road, the Noen Phra / Choeng Noen area — the city's main artery, where most hotels sit, near Passione mall, Star IT Center, and the markets, with easy walking to food · The old town center — near markets and local restaurants, good if you want to soak up city life · Mae Ramphueng Beach — east of the city, about 12–17 km out, for people who want to sleep near the sea but still get into town easily · If your main destination is Koh Samet, the Ban Phe pier is about 20 km from the city center (25–30 min by car).
secLabel: All 10 hotels — let's get into it

toc.name: Holiday Inn & Suites Rayong City Centre

entries.name: Holiday Inn & Suites Rayong City Centre
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.5 · 476 reviews · TripAdvisor #5 of 64 Rayong hotels
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Rayong city · next to Passione mall
entries.addr: 554/5 Sukhumvit Road, Noen Phra, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: If there's one hotel in Rayong city that reviewers call the "safest" pick for people who don't want to take a chance, many point to this one — Holiday Inn & Suites Rayong City Centre is a 4-star city hotel in the IHG group, a tall tower in the heart of the city that connects straight into the Passione Shopping Destination on Sukhumvit Road · It's the highest-scoring of these 10 at 9.5 from 476 reviews on Trip.com, and TripAdvisor ranks it #5 of 64 hotels in Rayong · The thing reviews mention most is the rooftop infinity pool on the 29th floor, looking out over the city skyline against the Gulf of Thailand — a lot of people say it's a spot you "have to go up and try" in the evening before sunset · There are 288 rooms and suites to choose from, from a Superior that's roomier than the typical city hotel up to a Deluxe Sea View that many reviews recommend for the Gulf view that's worth the price difference · The point guests agree on most is that the rooms are very clean, spacious, and modern, the Soft & Firm beds and pillows are comfortable, water pressure is good, and the breakfast buffet has plenty of variety · Being attached to the mall helps a lot, because after a tiring day at work you just walk down to find restaurants, a food court, and a supermarket, all without going out into the sun or calling a car · The honest caveats from reviews: this is a city hotel, not a beachfront resort, so if you're set on falling asleep to the waves you'll need to drive on to Mae Ramphueng Beach about 12–15 km away. A few reviews ran into in-room items like the kettle or door lock not working properly now and then, the rooftop food quality being inconsistent on some servings, and the Wi-Fi signal sometimes not being strong enough for bandwidth-heavy work · Bottom line: if you want the most convenient, most predictable city base in Rayong — for a work trip, a conference, family, or a stopover before crossing to Samet — this is the most solid choice.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pick a Deluxe Sea View or a high-floor room and request a sea/city view at the time of booking, because the price difference is worth the view you get · And head up to the 29th-floor infinity pool in the evening before sunset to catch both the light and the view in one frame.
pros: Highest score in this group, 9.5 — rooms are spacious, modern, and very clean
29th-floor rooftop infinity pool with city and Gulf views (the most-praised feature in reviews)
Walk straight into Passione mall for food and essentials
Predictable IHG-group cleanliness and service standards
cons: It's a city hotel, not a beachfront resort — you have to drive to the sea
Some in-room items work imperfectly now and then (per reviews)
Wi-Fi signal may not be strong enough for bandwidth-heavy work

entries.name: PLAAI Prime Hotel Rayong
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.2 · 413 reviews · formerly D Varee Diva Central

rooms.type: PLAAI Prime Suite One Bedroom (~69 sqm)

entries.addr: 590 Sukhumvit Road, Noen Phra, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: First thing to know before you search: PLAAI Prime Hotel Rayong originally opened as D Varee Diva Central Rayong and is now run under the PLAAI Hotels Group brand — so if you see the D Varee name on some platforms, no need to wonder, it's the same place, same building, same location · This is a 4-star city hotel on Sukhumvit Road positioned as a design hotel that looks more modern than its price, scoring 9.2 from 413 reviews on Trip.com · Reviews mention two things most often — one is the location, just about a 3-minute walk to Passione mall and around 9 minutes to Mo Sa Roj Market, so you can head out for dinner or shopping without calling a car · The other is the semi-open bathroom with a freestanding bathtub and a rain shower, which many people say is the detail that makes it feel special for the price · Rooms start from a Deluxe of about 30 sqm that's nicely laid out, up to a Studio Suite with a pool view and a One Bedroom Suite of about 69 sqm · Plenty of reviews agree the beds are very comfortable, the rooms look great, the breakfast is varied and tasty, and the staff are friendly and bilingual · There's an outdoor pool that many say is clean and gets good sun, plus a gym for anyone who wants to work out · The honest caveats from reviews: the building is starting to show its age in places, with curtains, towels, and furniture in some rooms looking less than fresh, some rooms have a leaky bathtub, some gym equipment could use an upgrade, and rooms facing Sukhumvit Road get some traffic noise · Bottom line: among Rayong's city hotels, PLAAI Prime is one of the most balanced for looks, convenience, and value, well suited to couples and anyone who cares about the room's atmosphere and taking good photos.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the bathtub matters to you, ask ahead for a renovated room to avoid leak issues · And if you're a light sleeper, request an inner room not facing Sukhumvit Road at the time of booking, because that road has traffic all the time.
pros: Rooms look more modern than the price suggests, with a bathtub in a semi-open bathroom
3-min walk to Passione mall and 9 min to Mo Sa Roj Market
Varied, tasty breakfast and very comfortable beds
Starts at ฿1,100 and stays affordable, with friendly bilingual staff
cons: The building is aging; curtains/towels/furniture look less than fresh in some spots
Some rooms have a leaky bathtub · some gym equipment is getting old (per reviews)
Right on Sukhumvit Road; road-facing rooms get traffic noise

entries.name: Kameo Grand Rayong
entries.badge: 🍳 Kitchen in every room · long stays
entries.addr: 305/14 Sukhumvit Road, Noen Phra, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: If you're coming to Rayong for a long stay, working for a week or a month, Kameo Grand Rayong is the place designed directly for that — a 4-star hotel and serviced apartment in the Kasemkij group (Kameo Collection) in central Rayong on Sukhumvit Road, scoring 8.8 from 64 reviews on Trip.com · What sets it apart from a typical city hotel is that every room is apartment-style with a built-in kitchen, from a Studio Suite that suits couples or solo travelers up to One Bedroom and Two Bedroom Suites with separate bedrooms and living rooms and a full kitchen, well suited to families or groups traveling together · Having a kitchen means you can cook for yourself, which is cheaper and more convenient for a long stay — a big reason people working in the industrial estates choose it · A highlight reviews mention is the rooftop pool and steakhouse with a nice atmosphere to relax in the evening, plus a free mall shuttle and free parking that help with getting around · Service is a point that earns praise in reviews, with staff who pay attention · The honest caveats: it's a building that's been open a while, so some rooms are starting to show their age and feel plainer than expected, the facilities score middling, and it's a city hotel away from the sea, with Mae Ramphueng Beach about 15–25 min by car · Bottom line: it's best for people who value a "room with a kitchen you can genuinely live in long-term" on an affordable budget, more than anyone after brand-new rooms or a resort feel.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a multi-day stay, choose a One Bedroom Suite or above for the full kitchen and a separate living area — better value per night · And use the hotel's free mall shuttle instead of calling a car yourself.
pros: Every room has a built-in kitchen so you can cook — great for long stays and families
Rooftop pool and steakhouse with a nice evening atmosphere
Free mall shuttle and free parking · service earns praise
Central location on Sukhumvit Road, close to the mall and markets
cons: The building has been open a while; some rooms are aging and plainer than the lobby
Facilities score middling compared to others in this group
It's a city hotel, not by the sea (per reviews)

entries.name: Star Convention Hotel
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.8 · 123 reviews · attached to Star IT Center
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Rayong city · attached to Star IT Center
entries.addr: 115 Soi Rayong Trade Center 4, Sukhumvit Road, Choeng Noen, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: Star Convention Hotel is a 4-star city hotel with two of the clearest selling points around — larger-than-standard rooms and being attached to the Star IT Center mall, which you can just walk down into · It sits on Sukhumvit Road in Choeng Noen, scoring 8.8 from 123 reviews on Trip.com · The rooms are what guests consistently emphasize, because here even the entry rooms run about 32 sqm, up to a Family Suite as large as 124 sqm — so large that many say you get more space than you pay for, ideal for bigger families or anyone wanting a roomy long stay · Grand Deluxe rooms and above have a microwave and fridge, and some have crockery, so you can reheat food yourself · The facilities highlight is having two pools plus a gym and sauna, more complete than many city hotels at the same price · Breakfast and service earn praise, with a service score around 9.0, and the location near the Rayong bus terminal is convenient for anyone arriving by coach · The honest caveats from reviews: the building is older, with plainer, more dated decor and furniture than newer design hotels, so the room and facilities scores land mid-range, and it's a city hotel away from the sea, with Mae Ramphueng Beach about 17 km away · Bottom line: it's best for people who value room space per baht and the convenience of being attached to a mall — for work trips, conferences, seminars, or long stays — more than anyone after a stylish, modern room.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're traveling as a group or staying long, the Family Suite and Grand Deluxe Corner give the best space per baht in this group · And use the Star IT Center right next door as your base for food and evening snacks.
pros: Larger-than-standard rooms — Family Suite up to 124 sqm
Attached to the Star IT Center mall, just walk down
Two pools, a gym, and a sauna — more complete than the price suggests
Good breakfast and praised service · near the Rayong bus terminal
cons: The building is older, with plain and dated room decor and furniture
Room and facilities scores land mid-range
It's a city hotel, not a beachfront resort (per reviews)

entries.name: Classic Kameo Rayong
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Noen Phra · Rayong city · near markets
entries.addr: 11 Soi Ratsadabamrung 6, Noen Phra, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: Classic Kameo Rayong is another sibling in the Kameo family, set on Soi Ratsadabamrung 6 in the Noen Phra area, and it's the one reviewers say you "can actually live in" on an affordable budget — scoring 8.8 from 175 reviews on Trip.com, a notably larger review base than Kameo Grand · It's a 4-star hotel and serviced apartment where many room types have a small built-in kitchen, fridge, and microwave, especially the Studio and Studio Suite that suit long stays or families, while the Standard and Deluxe suit shorter stays · The point that earns the highest praise is the service, with a score touching 9.2, and cleanliness at 9.1 — reviews mention well-looking-after staff and consistently clean rooms · The facilities highlight is having both an indoor and an outdoor pool plus a sauna, with the indoor pool being a plus on rainy or harsh-sun days · It's within about 700–800 m walking distance of the Star Night Bazaar and Star IT Center, so food is easy to find, and Mo Saroch Market is about 5 min by car · The varied breakfast is another point reviews praise · The honest caveats: the rooms are plainer than the good-looking lobby, some spots are aging with the building, so the room score lands below the service score, and it's a city hotel away from the sea, with Saeng Chan Beach about 10–15 min by car and Mae Ramphueng Beach about 16 km · Bottom line: it suits people who want a room with a kitchen, good service, and both indoor and outdoor pools, on a budget in the low-thousands.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a long stay, choose a Studio or Studio Suite for the small kitchen so you can cook for yourself · And the indoor pool is a good fallback on rainy or harsh-sun days — make the most of it.
pros: Many room types have a small built-in kitchen — great for long stays and families
Service scores high at 9.2 and cleanliness at 9.1 (per reviews)
Has both an indoor and an outdoor pool, plus a sauna
Walk to the Star Night market and Star IT Center for easy food
cons: Rooms are plainer than the lobby; some spots are aging with the building
The room score lands below the service score
It's a city hotel, not a seaside resort (per reviews)

entries.name: Rayong City Hotel
entries.addr: 11 Ratsadabamrung Road, Soi 4, Choeng Noen, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: If budget is the main concern and you just want a roomy bed in the city with the basic facilities all there, Rayong City Hotel is the one reviewers say is so good-value it's hard to find a rival — a 3.5-star city hotel on Ratsadabamrung Road in central Rayong, scoring 8.1 from 109 reviews on Trip.com · The clear selling point is the price starting in the low thousands, with a Queen Superior from about ฿1,000, moving up to a Queen Deluxe and a One-Bedroom Queen Suite with a separate living area · With around 250 rooms, this is a large hotel that can handle groups and tours · The highest-scoring category is value at 8.6, followed by location, reflecting that guests feel they get more than they pay for · It has a pool, breakfast, and free parking all included, and the central location lets you walk to restaurants and markets all around the hotel, near Star IT Center and Star Night Bazaar · Helpful staff are a point reviews praise · The honest caveats to know before booking: this is an older building that's seen plenty of use, with aging furniture and bathrooms in some rooms, the room category scores 7.6 — the lowest in this group — and the soundproofing between rooms isn't great · Bottom line: if you set your expectation at "affordable, central, roomy, basics covered" rather than newness or luxury, this delivers value that's hard to find in Rayong city.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a renovated room on a higher floor or the quieter side at the time of booking, because the soundproofing between rooms isn't great · And compare prices with Golden City and Hop Inn, which sit at a similar budget level, before deciding.
pros: Prices start in the low thousands — so good-value it's hard to find a rival (value score 8.6)
Central Rayong; walk to restaurants and markets all around the hotel
Has a pool, breakfast, and free parking all included
Large hotel, ~250 rooms, with helpful staff
cons: Older building; aging furniture and bathrooms in some rooms
Room category scores 7.6, the lowest in this group
Soundproofing between rooms isn't great (per reviews)

entries.name: Kantary Bay Rayong
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.0 · 157 reviews · on Mae Ramphueng Beach
entries.badge: 🌊 Cross the road to the beach · has a kitchen
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Mae Ramphueng Beach · Noen Phra (~15 min out of town)
tags: 🌊 Cross the road to Mae Ramphueng Beach
entries.addr: 50, 50/2 Chai Hat Road, Noen Phra, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: In this group, Kantary Bay Rayong is the exception on location — it's not in the city center but on Mae Ramphueng Beach, right across from the sand, just cross the road to reach it, about 15 min by car from Rayong city, so it suits people who want to sleep near the sea but still get into town easily · It's a 4-star hotel and serviced apartment in the Kantary group, scoring 9.0 from 157 reviews on Trip.com — among the higher scores in the group · What impresses guests is that the rooms are spacious apartment-style with a built-in kitchen, from a Studio Suite up to a Two Bedroom Premier Suite that suits big families, and some units get a sea view — reviews consistently give high marks for the room, value, and facilities categories · The highlight is having 2 pools and plenty of activities, ideal for families with kids, plus a 7-Eleven and beachfront food trucks within a 1–2 minute walk · The Ban Phe pier to Koh Samet is only about 20 min by car · The honest caveats from reviews: Mae Ramphueng is a public beach you cross the road to reach, not a private beach in front of the hotel, some rooms are aging with the building, and some rooms get road noise · Bottom line: it's the best pick in this group for families or long-stay guests who want a spacious room with a kitchen and to be near the sea, while still getting back into town in not much time.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If a sea view matters, request a One Bedroom Premier Suite or above and ask for a unit facing the beach at the time of booking · And if you're a light sleeper, ask for a room not facing Chai Hat Road to avoid traffic noise.
pros: Cross the road to Mae Ramphueng Beach — near the sea but 15 min into town
Spacious apartment-style rooms with a kitchen — great for families and long stays
Has 2 pools and plenty of activities — good for kids
Score of 9.0, among the highest in the group · near the pier to Samet
cons: Mae Ramphueng is a public beach you cross the road to reach, not private
Not in the city center; about 15 min by car from town
Some rooms are aging, and some get road noise (per reviews)

entries.name: Golden City Rayong Hotel
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.2 · 395 reviews · newly renovated Wing C rooms

rooms.type: One Bedroom Suite (Wing C, new building)

entries.addr: 530/1 Sukhumvit Road, Noen Phra, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: Golden City Rayong Hotel is the 4-star city hotel with the largest review base in this group — 395 reviews on Trip.com, scoring 9.2, which tells you it's been proven by a lot of guests · It sits on Sukhumvit Road in the Noen Phra area in central Rayong · The thing to know before booking is that the hotel is split into 3 buildings (Wing A/B/C), with Wing C being the new, modern building where rooms are in better shape and reviews recommend you request it, while the older buildings are plainer and cheaper — matching the building to your expectations makes for a happier stay · There are several room tiers, starting at about ฿1,089 for a Deluxe Twin of around 29 sqm, moving up to a mountain-view Studio of about 37 sqm, a One Bedroom Suite in Wing C, and a Family Suite of about 85 sqm that suits big families or groups traveling together · The best-scoring categories are service and value, both at 9.2, reflecting that guests feel they get more than they pay for and that staff look after them well · A highlight drivers love is the large free parking, which is rare for a central-city hotel — no circling for a spot or paying extra to park — and the location is near Laemtong Plaza mall, about 500 m, with a 7-Eleven and restaurants across the road within walking distance · The honest caveats from reviews: rooms don't soundproof well between each other, the pool is small, room condition clearly varies by building (the older buildings are plainer and more dated than Wing C), and it's a city hotel away from the sea, with Mae Ramphueng Beach about 16 km, around 20–25 min by car · Bottom line: it's best for work trips, seminars, families driving in, and anyone who wants a central stopover with easy parking before crossing to Samet — just specify Wing C, the new building, when booking and you'll be happiest.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Specify a room in Wing C, the new building, at the time of booking, because room condition is clearly better than the older buildings · And if you're a light sleeper, ask for a higher floor or the quieter side, since reviews say rooms don't soundproof well.
pros: Largest review base in the group, 395 reviews · service and value scores 9.2
Wing C is the new building, with rooms in good shape and a modern style
Large free parking — rare for a central-city hotel
Starts at ฿1,089, near Laemtong Plaza mall, about 500 m
cons: Rooms don't soundproof well · the pool is small
Room condition varies by building; you have to pick Wing C correctly
It's a city hotel, not by the sea (per reviews)

entries.type: 4-Star Modern City Hotel · In a Garden
entries.name: Tamarind Garden Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Choeng Noen · Rayong city (set back in a garden)
entries.addr: 30/1 Soi Ruean Khwan, Sukhumvit Road, Choeng Noen, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: If you want peace and quiet without going out to stay outside the city, Tamarind Garden Hotel is the one that fits that best in this group — a 4-star city hotel set back in a garden on Soi Ruean Khwan in the Choeng Noen area, giving it a quieter feel than hotels right on Sukhumvit Road, where you wake to trees instead of traffic · What sends its scores up is that the hotel was just renovated in 2024, scoring 9.1 from 135 reviews on Trip.com, with cleanliness touching 9.4 and rooms at 9.2 — among the top of this group · The point reviews most agree on is the spacious rooms with a private balcony in every room, from a Superior at 32 sqm up to a Deluxe at 36 sqm, a Grand Deluxe at 40 sqm, and a Family Room with bunk beds for families with kids — rooms are clean like new, comfortably decorated, and the balcony lets you sip morning coffee outside · There's a garden pool, attentive service that scores 9.3, and free parking with an EV charger, a genuine plus for anyone driving an electric car · The honest caveat to understand before booking: this location suits people with a car, because there are few restaurants within walking distance and it isn't attached to a mall like others in the group, so the location category scores 8.6, clearly below the others, and it's away from the sea, with Saeng Chan Beach about 15 min by car and the Ban Phe pier for the boat to Koh Samet about 30–40 min · Bottom line: it's best for people with a car who value a clean new room, garden quiet, and a private balcony more than the convenience of walking to restaurants and a mall.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: This place suits people with a car most, because there are few restaurants within walking distance — plan for transport and use the free EV charger if you drive an electric car · Choose the Grand Deluxe if you want an extra-spacious room with a balcony.
pros: Just renovated in 2024; rooms are clean like new (cleanliness 9.4)
A garden hotel in the city, quieter than roadside hotels
Spacious rooms with a private balcony in every room · garden pool
Free parking with an EV charger
cons: Location suits people with a car; few restaurants within walking distance (location 8.6)
Not attached to a mall like others in the group
Away from the sea; Saeng Chan Beach about 15 min by car (per reviews)

entries.name: Hop Inn Rayong
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Noen Phra · Rayong city · on Sukhumvit
entries.addr: 355/3 Sukhumvit Road, Noen Phra, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: Closing out the group with the lightest budget — Hop Inn Rayong, a budget hotel in the Erawan Group (HOP INN) on Sukhumvit Road in the Noen Phra area, impressive in that it scores as high as 9.3 from 124 reviews on Trip.com despite a price starting at only about ฿650/night · The secret of Hop Inn is consistency — the room standard is the same at every branch nationwide: a room of about 20 sqm, clean, with a big comfortable bed, air-con, TV, fridge, and an en-suite bathroom with hot water, nothing flashy but everything you need for a night's sleep · The cleanliness category touches 9.4 and value 9.3, reflecting that guests get exactly what they expect every time · It has free parking and a 24-hour front desk, good for people arriving late or passing through · The location on Sukhumvit Road is easy to find since it's on a main road, near Strawberry Town about 700 m, with a night market and convenience stores within walking distance, and onward transport to Saeng Chan Beach, the Mid-Water Pagoda, and the Ban Phe pier to cross to Koh Samet, all reachable in about 25–30 min · The honest caveat to set your expectation straight before booking: this is pure budget — no pool, no restaurant, no breakfast, and no sea view — the room is small at about 20 sqm, the facilities category scores 8.3, the lowest on that front compared to others in the group, and the hotel is on a main road with some passing traffic noise, especially in road-facing rooms · But at a few hundred baht, that's the trade-off, and most guests understand it and give high scores because they got exactly what they expected · Bottom line: if you just want a clean, good-value room in a central, easy-to-find location with free parking — for passing through, arriving late, or a single workday and out — Hop Inn is the safest, most predictable answer at this budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Hop Inn has no breakfast, so plan to grab food at Strawberry Town or a nearby convenience store · And if you're a light sleeper, ask for a room not facing Sukhumvit Road to avoid traffic noise.
pros: Prices start at about ฿650/night, the best value in the group — value score 9.3
Clean rooms to the Hop Inn standard, the same at every branch (cleanliness 9.4)
Free parking and a 24-hour front desk
Easy to find on Sukhumvit, near markets and convenience stores
cons: No pool, no restaurant, no sea view
Small rooms, ~20 sqm · facilities 8.3, the lowest on that front
On a main road, with some traffic noise (per reviews)

advice.head: Want a photogenic room with a bathtub
advice.bodyHtml: → PLAAI Prime Hotel Rayong ฿1,100, modern design, semi-open bathroom with a bathtub, 3-min walk to Passione (formerly D Varee Diva Central)

advice.head: Coming for a long stay, want a room with a kitchen
advice.bodyHtml: → Kameo Grand ฿2,200 or Classic Kameo ฿1,300, apartment-style rooms with a built-in kitchen so you can cook — great for week-long stays

advice.head: Traveling as a group, want the most spacious room
advice.bodyHtml: → Star Convention Hotel ฿1,200, Family Suite up to 124 sqm, attached to Star IT Center, with 2 pools + a sauna

advice.head: Limited budget, want the best value
advice.bodyHtml: → Hop Inn Rayong ฿650, clean rooms to a consistent standard · Rayong City Hotel ฿1,000, spacious rooms with the basics covered · Golden City ฿1,089, free parking

advice.head: Want a new room, quiet, and have a car
advice.bodyHtml: → Tamarind Garden Hotel ฿1,100, a garden hotel renovated in 2024, a balcony in every room, free parking + an EV charger

advice.head: Want to sleep near the sea but still reach the city

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates from the standard-room range and may change by date and season; we recommend checking the real price and comparing 3 sites before every booking · The scores and highlights in this article come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms, not from staying ourselves · PLAAI Prime Hotel Rayong was formerly named D Varee Diva Central Rayong — it's the same place, same building, same location · Golden City is split into 3 buildings; ask for Wing C, the new building, to get the best room condition · Kantary Bay is on Mae Ramphueng Beach outside the city, about 15 min out, not in the center, but is included for people who want to sleep near the sea · During long holidays and festivals when Bangkok crowds head to the Eastern beaches, Rayong city hotels fill up fast and prices rise, so book ahead · Rayong has no rail transit; getting around is by car, Grab, or songthaew, and it's about 2.5–3 hours from Bangkok · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — Common questions travelers ask about Rayong city hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best hotel in Rayong city?
faq.a: It depends on your travel style · If you go by score and international-brand standards, Holiday Inn & Suites Rayong City Centre has the highest score in the article at 9.5, is attached to Passione mall, and has a 29th-floor infinity pool · If you go by review count and value, Golden City Rayong Hotel has the largest review base at 395 reviews, a score of 9.2, and free parking · If you want a stylish room with a bathtub, PLAAI Prime · For a long stay with a kitchen, Kameo Grand or Classic Kameo · And for the lightest budget, Hop Inn from ฿650

faq.q: ❓ How much do Rayong city hotels cost?
faq.a: In this article, prices start at about ฿650–2,400 per night · On the budget side is Hop Inn from ฿650, and Rayong City Hotel / Golden City / PLAAI Prime / Tamarind Garden from about ฿1,000–1,100 · Mid-range is Star Convention at ฿1,200 and Classic Kameo at ฿1,300 · Higher up is Holiday Inn at ฿1,800, Kameo Grand at ฿2,200, and Kantary Bay at ฿2,400 · All prices are approximate starting rates from standard rooms; during long holidays prices may be higher than usual

faq.q: ❓ For a trip to Rayong, is it better to stay in the city or by the sea?
faq.a: It depends on your purpose · If you're coming to work, attend conferences or seminars, deal with the industrial estates, or stop over passing through, staying in the city is most convenient, since it's near malls, markets, restaurants, and easy onward travel · If your main goal is to swim in the sea and fall asleep to the waves every day, you should stay on the Mae Ramphueng Beach side, Mae Phim Beach, or cross over to Koh Samet · The middle path is Kantary Bay, on Mae Ramphueng Beach but only about 15 min from the city — you get both the sea and the convenience

faq.q: ❓ Which Rayong city hotels are attached to a mall?
faq.a: Several · Holiday Inn & Suites connects straight into Passione mall · PLAAI Prime is about a 3-minute walk to Passione · Star Convention Hotel is attached to the Star IT Center mall · Golden City is near Laemtong Plaza mall, about 500 m · And Classic Kameo is within about 700–800 m walking distance of the Star IT Center and Star Night Bazaar — good for people who want to walk to find food and shop without calling a car

faq.q: ❓ What kind of Rayong stay suits families or long stays?
faq.a: For a long stay or a family, a room with a built-in kitchen is the best value · Kameo Grand and Classic Kameo are serviced apartments with in-room kitchens so you can cook for yourself · Kantary Bay also has spacious apartment rooms with a kitchen by the beach · And for the largest room per baht, there's Star Convention, with a Family Suite up to 124 sqm, and Golden City, with a Family Suite of about 85 sqm and free parking

faq.q: ❓ How far in advance should you book a Rayong city hotel?
faq.a: Normally 1–2 weeks is enough, since most city hotels have plenty of rooms (many have 200–340 rooms) · But during long holidays and festivals when Bangkok crowds head to the Eastern beaches (Songkran, New Year, long weekends), book 3–4 weeks ahead or more, because rooms fill up fast and prices climb, especially the popular Holiday Inn and Golden City · Every platform offers Free Cancellation, so it's worth locking in a price early if your plans aren't certain, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com to get the best rate
